setup: Deal one Startup per player; set unused Startups aside.

cards.name: Rockstar CTO
cards.effect: Place face-up in your startup and add its valuation.

cards.name: Viral Launch
cards.effect: Place face-up in your startup and add its valuation.
cards.flavor: The internet has entered the chat.

cards.name: Major Funding Round
cards.effect: Place face-up in your startup and add its valuation.
cards.flavor: Zero revenue. Somehow a Series B.

cards.name: Poach
cards.effect: Take 1 banked card from a rival's startup into yours. You gain its value; they lose it. Do not take a Startup or an active effect. Discard this.
cards.flavor: Nice startup. Can we borrow something?

cards.name: Founder Scandal
cards.effect: Privately look at every card in 1 rival's hand. Choose 1 to steal into your hand. Only you see the hand. Discard this card.
cards.flavor: Your pitch deck leaked. So did the group chat.

cards.name: PR Crisis
cards.effect: Place beside a rival's startup as a -$75M valuation penalty. It stays until removed by Crisis PR Team.

cards.name: Patent Lawsuit
cards.effect: Place beside a rival's startup. They skip their next entire turn, including the draw, then discard this. Only 1 pending Lawsuit per player.
cards.flavor: See you in court. Bring snacks.

cards.name: Cease & Desist
cards.effect: Return 1 Viral Launch from a rival's startup to their hand. They discard down to 7 if needed. Best Lawyers in Town can block this. Discard this.
cards.flavor: Our lawyers would like a word.

cards.name: Golden Handcuffs
cards.effect: React to a Poach targeting you: cancel it. Discard this and the Poach. The targeted card stays in your startup.

cards.name: Best Lawyers in Town
cards.effect: React to Patent Lawsuit or Cease & Desist targeting you: cancel it. Discard this and the attack.
cards.flavor: Our hourly rate is a power move.

cards.name: Crisis PR Team
cards.effect: React: cancel Founder Scandal or PR Crisis targeting you. Or use 1 card play to remove 1 active PR Crisis from your startup. Discard this.

outcome.headline: STOP THE CRISIS
outcome.caption: BLOCK SCANDAL / CANCEL OR CLEAR PR CRISIS

cards.name: Not For Sale
cards.effect: React: cancel an Investor targeting you. No card changes hands and no valuation is added. Discard this and the Investor.

cards.name: Investor
cards.effect: Give a rival this card face-up for +$50M valuation. Take 1 random card from their hidden hand. They must have a card to exchange. The Investor stays in their startup.
cards.flavor: I believed in you. Five minutes ago.

cards.name: Neural AI
cards.effect: Start at $50M. Deal 1 Startup to each player. Keep it face-up; it cannot be stolen or discarded. All Startup types use the same rules.
cards.flavor: We put AI in it. Obviously.

cards.name: Flash Commerce
cards.effect: Start at $50M. Deal 1 Startup to each player. Keep it face-up; it cannot be stolen or discarded. All Startup types use the same rules.

cards.name: FinPay
cards.effect: Start at $50M. Deal 1 Startup to each player. Keep it face-up; it cannot be stolen or discarded. All Startup types use the same rules.

cards.name: RocketWorks
cards.effect: Start at $50M. Deal 1 Startup to each player. Keep it face-up; it cannot be stolen or discarded. All Startup types use the same rules.

cards.name: Biotech
cards.effect: Start at $50M. Deal 1 Startup to each player. Keep it face-up; it cannot be stolen or discarded. All Startup types use the same rules.

cards.name: Your Turn
cards.effect: Draw 1. Play up to 2: bank a card OR use its effect. Keep at most 7 in hand. Add your startup and banked values; subtract active PR Crises. End your turn at $1,000M or more to win.
